shared.max_runs_counts: Every atomically reserved RUN_ID, including blocked and failed RUNS
shared.session_budget: Atomically reserve SUM dimensions cumulatively, ACTIVE_COUNT for concurrent RUNS, and ACTIVE_SUM for simultaneous worst-case memory, per OP1_RESOURCE_BUDGET_SCHEMA. Unknown reservation is not refunded without authoritative proof.
shared.expiry: No new RUN admission/workload after expiry; bounded proven-owned teardown and read-only reconciliation require their own safety scope.
shared.revocation: Stops future admissions at authoritative boundary; in-flight stop follows actuator/ownership contract and is not presumed instantaneous.
shared.default: DENY; UNKNOWN prestate, ownership, or authority blocks admission.

EXPERIMENTAL_REUSABLE.fault_injection: Named, bounded, explicitly authorized per RUN; preserve failures and raw bytes.
EXPERIMENTAL_REUSABLE.network_boundary: loopback only by default; external network denied
EXPERIMENTAL_REUSABLE.resource_rule: Explicit numeric session and run ceilings required at mint.

OPERATIONAL_REUSABLE.network_boundary: loopback only by default; external network denied
OPERATIONAL_REUSABLE.prestate: Fresh independent source/policy/host exclusivity/ownership observations immediately before every claim.
OPERATIONAL_REUSABLE.resource_rule: Per-resource limits strictly no greater than experimental profile and exact numeric values required at mint.
